method: Compare the final visible post with the 16-source pre-output reading notes, then verify a detected source-price date against the exchange calendar. This check is separate from the model review.

disqualifying_finding.source_issue: The source ties the KODEX200 price and 80.76% year-to-date return to September 20, 2026; its comparison period explicitly ends on that date. That date was Sunday and not a KRX session.
disqualifying_finding.final_post_issue: The final main post repeats the 80.76% return as a September 20 comparison and adds a WTI comparison from the same source without flagging the source-date inconsistency or obtaining an independent point-in-time price.
disqualifying_finding.model_false_positive: The model reviewer marked numbers, timing, sources and coverage true and listed this source as covered; this does not resolve the calendar contradiction.
disqualifying_finding.required_resolution: Exclude the precise ETF price/return and linked comparison until a separate historical market-price source establishes the valid session date and values, or prominently identify the discrepancy rather than presenting them as reliable historical returns.

offline_scope: No Slack post or live scheduling qualification; current historical lake snapshot was unavailable.
